blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board (LTFRB) has imposed a P555.75-million penalty on motorcycle taxi platform Move It for exceeding its authorized number of rider-partners. Move It was authorized to operate only 17,746 rider-partners across Metro Manila, Cebu City and Cagayan de Oro but exceeded this limit by 55,575 riders, according to the LTFRB. READ: Motorcycle taxi riders group backs provisional authority registration The board imposed a fine of P10,000 for each unauthorized rider, bringing the total penalty to P555.75 million.
